title: Six Hundred Words and Eleven Notebooks
subtitle: 文学写作 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 文学写作（文学艺术与体育·文学与写作）
meta: 主题语境：文学写作（文学艺术与体育·文学与写作）　|　核心词汇：story　|　正文 393 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 story 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: My mother wrote ① stories for forty years and published none of them, which my father called a hobby and she called a job. She said a ② story is not a thing you make up but a thing you remember properly, and that most people remember badly on purpose. She wrote longhand at the kitchen table before the rest of us were awake, and never once let me read a page of a story.

When she was nineteen she worked for a newspaper in the county town, and the ③ story they gave her on her first day was a fire at a mill, six hundred words by six o'clock. She wrote it in an hour and they printed it the next morning under somebody else's name. She said the only true thing in it was the number of the mill, and that a reporter learns that in a week. A story, she said, is what is left when the number is taken away.

Her ④ story, as she told it to me, was that she left because the paper would not print the name of the mill owner. The owner's account was that the fire had been an accident, and the paper printed that. My mother said then that a story somebody pays for is not a story but an advertisement, and she came home on the Thursday and did not go back on Friday. That was the last story she wrote for money.

After that she worked in an office three ⑤ stories above a bank, and she ⑥ told stories there too, to the women she typed with, every Monday, about a family in a house by the river who never once agreed on anything. They said it was the ⑦ same old story every week, and she said that was the whole point, that nothing anybody tells you twice is ever quite the same.

⑧ To make a long story short, she never published a line, and when she died we found eleven notebooks in the drawer of the kitchen table. I read one and stopped at page nine. My mother's ⑨ story about the mill was six hundred words long, and the ⑩ story of her life was that she had written it in an hour, at nineteen, and had spent forty years remembering it properly. No story, she thought, is ever finished; it is only stopped.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 故事；小说；叙述
B. n. 经历；往事；身世
C. n. 报道；新闻（news story）
D. n. 说法；一方的陈述（one's side of the story）
F. 固定搭配：tell a story / tell stories 讲故事
G. 固定搭配：the same old story 老一套；老生常谈
H. 固定搭配：to make a long story short 长话短说

items.q: My mother wrote stories for forty years
She said a story is not a thing you make up
the story they gave her on her first day
Her story, as she told it to me
in an office three stories above a bank
and she told stories there too

To make a long story short, she never published
My mother's story about the mill was six hundred
and the story of her life was that she

answers.why: stories 意为“故事、小说”，母亲写了四十年小说，一篇也没有发表。
a story 意为“经历、往事”，她说故事不是编出来的东西，而是被好好记住的经历。
the story 意为“（新闻）报道、稿件”，报社第一天交给她的是一篇关于工厂大火的报道。
Her story 意为“她的说法、她一方的陈述”，据她自己的说法，她离开是因为报社不肯登厂主的名字。
stories 意为“楼层”，她在银行楼上三层的办公室工作。
told stories 意为“讲故事”，她每周一也给一起打字的女同事们讲故事。
the same old story 意为“老一套、老生常谈”，她们说每周都是老一套。
to make a long story short 意为“长话短说”，长话短说，她一个字也没有发表过。
story 意为“（一篇）小说、故事”，母亲写的那篇关于工厂的故事只有六百词。
the story of her life 意为“她一生的经历、身世”，一生的经历是她十九岁时一小时写完了它，之后用四十年把它好好记住。
